items.html: However, GAR, which are the Mochin, and which must be complete mercy more than all the rest, since there are still judgments in them, are not yet revealed in the phase of Mochin, and only VAK alone were revealed. Then, once he was born and circumcised, the foreskin departed from him, and he entered another degree that has an addition of holiness, except that he is still Elohim and judgments.
